name: notes.junxiong.dev
notes: Tier-1 harness for this site (uipack docs/grading/tier-1.md). Run from a uipack checkout: npm run grade -- check <url> --spec <this repo>/uipack-grade.json. Faces: STYLE.md names system stacks (Iowan Old Style, ui-sans-serif, ui-monospace); the grader cannot map a CSS generic to the platform face it draws, so the faces macOS draws for them (.SF NS for ui-sans-serif and system-ui, SF Mono and Menlo for ui-monospace) are listed here. Whether to self-host faces instead is an open owner decision in STYLE.md. Text floors: the core 11px floor inside figures and HTML charts, 12px elsewhere.

textFloors.why: figure and Vega-Lite chart text floor (uipack tier-1, docs/system/style.md)
